instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/task-021_initial.scad in OpenSCAD. Use OpenSCAD command-line parameters or edit the source so width=90, depth=70, and back_height=80 (the back plate rises 80 mm above the 5 mm base, so overall height is 85 mm). Cut one rectangular slot through the back plate with size 12 x 8 x 32 mm, centered at x=0, y=32.5, z=25. The slot cutter therefore spans y=28.5..36.5 and passes completely through the back plate at y=30..35. Export the modified CAD model as /home/user/Desktop/task-021_output.stl. The task is to generate the modified model, not to submit a new script file. [Software] To use OpenSCAD, run `openscad` from a terminal. Run OpenSCAD from `/usr/bin/openscad` when working on `task-021_initial.scad`.
